regime_context: China A-shares theme detector shows Semiconductors (rank 1, durability 0.67, not crowded) and AI Compute & Optics (rank 2, durability 0.56) leading in momentum, with narrowing rotation and no directional handoff signal. However, backtest shows the trend gate did not reduce drawdown historically (mean-reverting tape), so the allocation framework has no validated edge here. Macro backdrop is dominated by AI/tech and geopolitics narratives with very high unscheduled surprise share, suggesting high single-name event risk.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: The detector’s momentum rank and durability leg identify Semiconductors as the theme where leadership and flow are currently concentrating, with trend-like breadth and no crowding. However, given the market’s historical mean-reversion and the failure of the trend gate to add edge, this is a conditional, low-confidence lean that the concentration persists absent a disruptive shock.

Breadth 0.545 suggests reasonable participation within the theme
